    Gluing a family of orthogonal bricks #

    For Kronecker modules C and B i (i : ι) and maps α i, β i : V_{B i} → W_C, the extension module E has V = V_C × ⨁ V_{B i}, W = W_C × ⨁ W_{B i} and block upper-triangular arrow maps. If C and the B i are pairwise Hom-orthogonal bricks and every component extension is non-split, E is a brick (Bricks.isBrick_extFamily).
